description: Codex is authenticated only through an API-key environment variable (common in CI). `codex login status` reports stored credentials only, so it prints 'Not logged in' and exits 1 even though `codex exec` would work. The adapter must skip `codex login status` when CODEX_API_KEY or OPENAI_API_KEY is non-empty and go on to `codex exec`; a 401 from `codex exec` remains the cli_auth_failed backstop.
backstop: A 401 or login error on codex exec stderr maps to cli_auth_failed.
